$Comment: Enchanter Orrin, standing in the Forgotten Temple beside Sawyer Marn, in the merchant cluster
where Marn and the Mastery Trainer flank the Rootling merchant's marker. Orrin is this pack's
character end to end: his role, this placement and the conversation pressing F opens all ship
here, so a server without the pack has no enchanter to stand up. Interact names a conversation
rather than a screen because Orrin has quests to hand out and lines to say before any list
opens; a screen name there would open that screen with no conversation at all. Author Open or
Dialogue, never both.
To take Orrin out without editing this file, set Enabled false in
mods/ziggfreedcommon/npc-placements.json.
Where targets the temple by its GameplayConfig key rather than by name: that key is the
engine's own per-world gameplay-config id ('ForgottenTemple' ships with the base game) and
it is the same every time the temple is entered, while the world NAME carries a fresh uuid
each time.
Requires keeps Orrin away until the stations feature is on, which means RPG Stations is
installed and switched on; with it off his quests do not exist either, so nothing dangles.
Lifecycle keeps his chunk loaded, puts him back if something removes him, and raises his
health beyond anything that can be dealt. All three matter for a quest giver: a delivery
quest whose character is not standing where the player is parks unpaid until they find him.
This placement authors no Identity.NpcId, so the character IS his role: the disenchanting
quests bind to Mmo_Enchanter, and any second placement of that role is the same enchanter,
offering and taking hand-ins for the same quests.
Anchor is the temple's own Rootling Merchant spawn marker, the same marker Marn and the Mastery
Trainer stand by, so the three move with the temple's actual layout instead of an offset from
the arrival spot that can land inside a wall. The trainer stands three blocks along positive X
from the marker and Marn three along negative X and one back along negative Z; Orrin stands two
blocks further along negative X than Marn, on the same line, facing the same way, so he is at
Marn's shoulder and clear of him. Both the Adventurer's Guide and Old Jack stand off the arrival
spot by the entrance, well away from this cluster. To move him, edit Anchor.Structure.Offset,
keeping it small enough to stay out of the walls, and Yaw to turn which way he faces; test the
spot in game, since the walls do not move for the offset. /mmonpc list --arg1=placements shows
whether the placement resolved, and --arg1=structures the marker ids the engine has seen.
Name: Mmo_Enchanter_Temple
